articles.title: [Column] Can Korea advocate peace while selling weapons of war?
articles.summary: 한국이 무기를 수출하면서 동시에 평화를 옹호할 수 있는지에 대한 논쟁을 다룹니다. 방산 수출 증가와 평화 외교 사이의 모순점을 살펴봅니다. 이 칼럼은 한국의 외교 정책 방향에 대한 중요한 질문을 제기합니다.
articles.learnerContent:
## Can Korea Advocate Peace While Selling Weapons of War?

South Korea has become one of the world's fastest-growing arms exporters in recent years. Korean-made tanks, artillery systems, and fighter jets are now being sold to countries in Europe, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. This growth in the defense industry has brought billions of dollars into the Korean economy. But it has also raised a serious question: Can a country truly stand for peace while profiting from weapons of war?

**Korea's Growing Defense Industry**

Korea's arms exports have grown dramatically. Companies like Hanwha and Korean Air have signed major deals with countries such as Poland, Australia, and the United Arab Emirates. The government has set ambitious goals to become one of the top four arms-exporting nations in the world. For many, this is a sign of Korea's growing industrial and technological strength.

However, critics argue that selling weapons is not a neutral act. Weapons sold today can be used in conflicts tomorrow. Once a country sells arms, it becomes connected — economically and politically — to the wars those weapons are used in.

**The Peace Argument**

South Korea often presents itself as a country that understands the pain of war. The Korean War (1950–1953) left millions dead and the peninsula divided. Because of this history, Korea has sometimes positioned itself as a voice for peace and diplomacy in international affairs.

Some argue that selling weapons contradicts this image. If Korea profits from other countries' conflicts, how can it honestly call for peaceful solutions? Critics say that arms sales can make conflicts worse by giving one side more military power, or by encouraging an arms race between rival nations.

**The Other Side**

Supporers of Korea's arms exports offer different arguments. First, they say that selling "defensive" weapons to allies and friendly democracies can actually help keep the peace. If a country can defend itself well, potential enemies may think twice before attacking.

Second, they point out that Korea is not alone. The United States, France, Germany, and the United Kingdom are all major arms exporters. If Korea does not sell weapons, other countries will simply fill that market instead.

Third, the defense industry creates jobs and develops advanced technology that can benefit civilian life as well.

**A Difficult Balance**

The debate is not simple. Most countries that export arms also have foreign policies that include diplomacy, aid, and calls for peace. The question is whether it is possible — or honest — to hold both positions at the same time.

For Korea, the challenge is especially meaningful because of its own history of war and division. As Korea grows into a larger role on the world stage, the choices it makes about weapons exports will shape how other nations see it — and how Koreans see themselves.

This is not just a question about economics or military strategy. It is a question about values: What kind of country does Korea want to be?

keyVocab.example: Many politicians advocate for stronger environmental protection laws.
His actions contradict his promise to help the poor.
The two countries resolved their dispute through diplomacy, not war.
An arms race between the two nations made the region less stable.
The company set an ambitious goal to double its sales within two years.

articles.title: The Ultra-Rich Are Moving to Miami, and Want Their Money Managers There, Too
articles.summary: 세금 혜택 등 다양한 이점으로 인해 초고액 자산가들이 마이애미로 이주하고 있습니다. 이들은 자신의 자산을 관리하는 금융 회사들도 함께 마이애미로 데려오고 있습니다.
articles.learnerContent:
## The Ultra-Rich Are Moving to Miami — and Bringing Their Money Managers With Them

Miami has long been known for its warm weather, beautiful beaches, and lively nightlife. But in recent years, it has become something else: a top destination for some of the wealthiest people in the United States.

### Why Are the Ultra-Rich Moving to Miami?

One of the biggest reasons is taxes. Florida has no state income tax, which means people who live there can keep more of their earnings. For extremely wealthy individuals — sometimes called the "ultra-rich" or "ultrawealthy" — this can mean saving millions of dollars every year compared to living in states like New York or California.

Beyond taxes, Miami offers a high quality of life. The city has luxury housing, world-class restaurants, and a growing business community. Many wealthy people also appreciate the relatively lower cost of real estate compared to cities like Manhattan or San Francisco, though prices in Miami have risen sharply in recent years.

The COVID-19 pandemic also played a role. When remote work became common, many wealthy professionals realized they no longer needed to live near their offices. This gave them the freedom to choose where they wanted to live — and many chose Miami.

### What Is a "Family Office"?

When someone is extremely wealthy, managing their money becomes a full-time job — sometimes for an entire team of people. This is where "family offices" come in. A family office is a private company that manages the finances of one very rich family or a small group of wealthy clients. These firms handle investments, taxes, legal matters, and even personal expenses.

As more ultra-rich individuals have moved to Miami, they have brought — or attracted — their family offices with them. These firms need physical office space, staff, and connections to local banks and legal professionals.

### Miami's Growing Financial Sector

This trend is changing Miami's identity. The city was once seen mainly as a tourism and entertainment hub. Now, it is developing a serious financial sector. New office buildings are being constructed to meet the demand from wealth management firms and family offices.

Local business leaders and city officials have welcomed this change. They see it as an opportunity to diversify Miami's economy and create high-paying jobs in finance and related industries.

However, not everyone is happy. Housing prices have increased significantly, making it harder for middle- and working-class residents to afford to live in the city. Critics argue that the arrival of the ultra-rich has contributed to inequality and pushed out long-time communities.

### A Shift in American Wealth Geography

Miami's rise as a wealth hub is part of a larger shift in where rich Americans choose to live. States with lower taxes and warmer climates are gaining wealthy residents, while traditional financial centers like New York are seeing some of their richest citizens leave.

For now, Miami seems well-positioned to continue attracting wealthy individuals and the financial firms that serve them. Whether the city can balance this growth with the needs of all its residents remains an important question.

keyVocab.example: The government offered tax incentives to attract new businesses to the region.
The ultra-rich often hire teams of professionals to manage their investments.

articles.title: Ariana Grande to Take ‘Step Back From Visibility’ After Tour Ends Amid ‘Public Scrutiny,’ Drops Out of ‘Sunday in the Park With George’ Musical
articles.summary: 아리아나 그란데가 '이터널 선샤인 투어' 종료 후 공개 활동을 잠시 중단할 예정입니다. 그녀의 대변인은 '지속적인 대중의 scrutiny(주목과 비판)'를 이유 중 하나로 밝혔습니다. 또한 그란데는 뮤지컬 '선데이 인 더 파크 위드 조지' 출연도 포기한 것으로 알려졌습니다.
articles.learnerContent:
## Ariana Grande Plans to Step Back From Public Life

Ariana Grande, one of the world's most famous pop stars and actresses, has announced that she will take a long break from public life. Her representative shared the news with the magazine *People*, saying that Grande will "step back from visibility" after her current tour ends.

### The Eternal Sunshine Tour

Grande is currently performing on her **Eternal Sunshine Tour**, which is named after her popular 2024 album *Eternal Sunshine*. Once the tour is finished, she plans to move away from the spotlight for an extended period of time. The tour has been a major event for her fans around the world.

### Why Is She Taking a Break?

According to her representative's official statement, one of the main reasons for this break is **"ongoing public scrutiny."** This means that Grande has been receiving a great deal of attention, criticism, and judgment from the public and media over a long period of time.

Being a celebrity at Grande's level means that almost every part of her personal and professional life is watched closely by millions of people. This kind of constant attention can be very difficult to manage, and many celebrities choose to take breaks to protect their mental health and well-being.

Grande is not the first major star to make this kind of decision. Artists such as Adele, Justin Bieber, and Selena Gomez have all taken breaks from public life at different points in their careers, often for similar reasons.

### Dropping Out of a Broadway Musical

Along with stepping back from public appearances, Grande has also **dropped out** of a planned Broadway musical called *Sunday in the Park with George*. This means she has decided not to take part in the production anymore.

*Sunday in the Park with George* is a classic American musical that first appeared on Broadway in 1984. It is based on the life of the French painter Georges Seurat and features music and lyrics by the legendary composer Stephen Sondheim. A new production of the show had been planned, and Grande was expected to play a leading role.

It is not yet clear who will replace Grande in the musical, or when the production will go ahead.

### Fan Reactions

Many of Grande's fans, known as "Arianators," have responded to the news with messages of support on social media. They have encouraged her to rest and take care of herself, saying that her health and happiness are more important than her career activities.

At the same time, some fans expressed disappointment about missing the chance to see her in the Broadway musical, which many had been looking forward to.

### What Comes Next?

No specific timeline has been given for how long Grande's break will last. Her team has not announced any new projects, albums, or performances for the near future.

For now, it seems that Ariana Grande is choosing to prioritize her personal well-being over her career — a decision that many people in and outside of the entertainment world are supporting.

keyVocab.example: The celebrity decided to reduce her visibility by staying away from social media.

keyVocab.meaning: 면밀한 검토, 세밀한 감시 또는 비판

articles.title: Massive Attack Banned from Singapore After Displaying Palestine Flag Onstage
articles.summary: 영국 밴드 Massive Attack이 싱가포르 공연에서 팔레스타인 국기를 들었다가 싱가포르 입국 금지 처분을 받았습니다. 밴드는 157개국이 인정한 주권 국가의 국기를 든 것이 법을 어길 것이라고 생각하지 못했다고 밝혔습니다.
articles.learnerContent:
## Massive Attack Banned from Singapore After Showing Palestine Flag

British music group Massive Attack has been banned from entering Singapore after a recent concert there. The ban came after band members held up the flag of Palestine during their performance on stage.

### What Happened?

During their show in Singapore, Massive Attack displayed the Palestinian flag in front of the audience. This action upset Singaporean authorities, who decided to ban the band from the country as a result.

Singapore has strict rules about political statements made at public events. The government controls what performers can say or show at concerts, especially on topics related to foreign conflicts or politics.

### The Band's Response

Massive Attack responded to the ban with an official statement. They expressed surprise at the decision and defended their action.

"We did not imagine that merely holding up the flag of a sovereign state recognized by 157 countries would violate any law," the band said.

The band's point is that Palestine is officially recognized as a country by 157 nations around the world. In their view, showing its flag should not be considered a political violation.

### Who Are Massive Attack?

Massive Attack is a well-known band from Bristol, England. They helped create a style of music called "trip-hop" in the 1990s. Their most famous album is *Mezzanine*, released in 1998. Songs like "Teardrop" and "Unfinished Sympathy" made them famous worldwide.

The band has a history of supporting political causes and using their music to speak about social issues. This is not the first time they have made a political statement at a concert.

### The Bigger Picture

This incident is part of a wider debate about whether musicians and artists should make political statements during their performances. Some people believe artists have a responsibility to speak about important world events. Others think concerts should remain free from politics.

Singapore is known for having tight controls on free speech and public expression. The government regularly monitors public events to make sure performers follow local rules.

For Massive Attack, being banned from Singapore means they cannot perform there in the future. It is unclear how long the ban will last.

### Reactions

The story has attracted attention from music fans and human rights supporters around the world. Many people have shown support for the band on social media. Others have pointed out that Singapore has the right to set its own laws for public events within its borders.

The situation raises an important question: where is the line between artistic freedom and following local laws while performing in another country?

keyVocab.example: The band received a ban from performing in the country again.
A sovereign state has the right to govern itself independently.
He did not know that his actions would violate local laws.
The authorities decided to take action after the concert.
Freedom of expression means people can share their opinions openly.

articles.title: For a Day, Google Made It Easy to Spoof Satellite Imagery
articles.summary: 구글이 AI를 이용해 가짜 위성 지도를 만들 수 있는 새로운 구글 어스 도구를 출시했습니다. 하지만 허위 정보 확산 우려로 비판이 쏟아지자 구글은 빠르게 해당 기능을 삭제했습니다.
articles.learnerContent:
## Google Briefly Let Users Create Fake Satellite Maps — Then Quickly Removed the Feature

For a short time, Google offered a tool that made it surprisingly easy to create fake satellite images. The feature, added to Google Earth, used artificial intelligence to generate realistic-looking but completely false maps. After strong public criticism and serious concerns about disinformation, Google removed the tool within a day.

### What Did the Tool Do?

The new feature was part of Google Earth, Google's well-known service that shows satellite images of locations around the world. The tool allowed users to use AI to edit or replace real satellite imagery with generated, fake visuals — a technique often called a "deepfake."

Deeply realistic AI-generated images are already a major concern in areas like politics and social media, where fake photos and videos can spread false information quickly. Applying this technology to maps added a new layer of worry. Satellite imagery is used by journalists, researchers, governments, and military organizations to verify events happening around the world. If such images can be easily faked, it becomes much harder to trust visual evidence.

### What Is "Spoofing"?

The word "spoof" means to trick or deceive someone by creating a fake version of something real. In this case, "spoofing satellite imagery" means replacing genuine satellite photos with AI-generated fakes that look real but show something that never happened — for example, making a building appear destroyed, or hiding military equipment.

This kind of manipulation could have serious consequences. Bad actors could use fake satellite images to spread false news about wars, natural disasters, or political events.

### The Backlash

After the tool was released, many users and experts quickly noticed its potential for misuse. Critics pointed out that the feature could easily be used to create disinformation — false information designed to mislead people. Security researchers and journalists raised alarms on social media, and news stories about the risks spread rapidly.

Google responded quickly. The company acknowledged the concerns and pulled the feature back, saying it needed to review the tool more carefully before making it available to the public again.

### Why Does This Matter?

This incident highlights a growing challenge in the age of AI: how to release powerful new tools responsibly. AI can do amazing things, but it can also be misused in ways that cause real harm. Companies like Google face pressure to innovate and offer exciting new features, but they also have a responsibility to consider how those features might be abused.

The speed with which Google removed the tool — and the strength of the public reaction — shows that people are increasingly aware of the dangers of AI-generated misinformation. As AI technology becomes more advanced and more widely available, questions about how to use it safely and ethically will only become more important.

For now, the fake satellite map tool is gone. But the broader conversation about AI, trust, and visual evidence is just beginning.

keyVocab.meaning: 딥페이크 (AI 기술로 만든 매우 사실적인 가짜 이미지나 영상)
